items.description: A date picker paired with a scrollable time slot list. Selecting a date updates the time slots shown. Disabled slots are unclickable.

items.name: comp-506
items.title: Comp 506
items.description: A calendar with preset shortcuts on the left (Today, Yesterday, Last week, Last month, Last year). Clicking a preset sets both the calendar view and selected date. Only past dates are selectable.

items.name: comp-507
items.title: Comp 507
items.description: Selects a start and end date using a calendar in range mode. Preset buttons set common ranges (Today, Last 7 days, Month to date, etc). Only past dates are available.

items.name: comp-508
items.title: Comp 508
items.description: Displays two consecutive months side-by-side in range mode. Uses paged navigation (forward/back arrows) to move through months. Separator line divides the two calendars.

items.name: comp-509
items.title: Comp 509
items.description: Displays three consecutive months in range mode, laid out responsively (stacked on mobile, side-by-side on desktop). Paged navigation moves through months. Separator lines divide the calendars.

items.name: comp-512
items.title: Comp 512
items.description: A labeled form control showing the selected date range or placeholder. Button displays 'Start - End' format. Popover contains a calendar in range mode for selecting both dates.

items.name: comp-510
items.title: Comp 510
items.description: Two-month calendar overlaying prices on each day. Good prices (under $100) are highlighted in emerald green. Custom DayButton component renders date + price. Dates without pricing data are disabled.

items.name: comp-511
items.title: Comp 511
items.description: A labeled form control with a button trigger showing the selected date or placeholder. Clicking opens a popover with a calendar. Uses Radix Popover and React DayPicker.

items.name: comp-544
items.title: Comp 544
items.description: Drag-and-drop upload area that displays selected image as full background when loaded. Shows upload instructions when empty; 5MB size limit.

items.name: comp-546

items.name: comp-545

items.name: comp-549

items.name: comp-548

items.description: Drag-and-drop area for one file with size/type validation, error display, and upload state feedback.

items.name: comp-547
items.title: Comp 547
items.description: Multi-image upload in list format, showing thumbnails, file names, and size. Each item has individual remove control.

items.name: comp-551
items.title: Comp 551
items.description: Multi-file upload manager using table layout. Shows file name, size, upload date, status with sortable columns and bulk actions.

items.name: comp-550

items.description: Multi-file upload showing icons based on file type (pdf, image, doc, etc). Supports mixed file types with individual removal.

items.name: comp-553

items.name: comp-552

items.description: Multi-file upload in icon grid layout. Each file shown as icon representation by type with name and size, removable.

items.name: comp-543

items.description: Masks a video element to only show through large text, using SVG data-URI as a CSS mask-image. Text content is extracted from children prop. Font size supports responsive vw units.

items.name: inspira-vortex
items.title: Vortex
items.description: Full-canvas particle vortex animation using simplex-noise for flow field direction. All animation state is kept in refs to avoid React re-render overhead. Wraps children in a relative z-10 div.

items.name: inspira-warp-background
items.title: Warp Background
items.description: 3D perspective grid with animated light beams on all four faces (top/bottom/left/right). Each Beam is a motion.div animating from y:100cqmax to y:-100% in a loop. Beam configs are memoized.

items.name: inspira-wavy-background
items.title: Wavy Background
items.description: Canvas-based animated wave background using simplex-noise 3D for smooth wave shapes. Handles Safari blur fallback. Resizes canvas to parent dimensions on mount and window resize.

items.name: inspira-world-map
items.title: World Map
items.description: Interactive dotted world map with animated curved connection lines between lat/lng coordinate pairs. Uses dotted-map for SVG generation and motion/react for path-draw animations.
